issues.description: The Book struct declares its title property with a private access modifier but Client.main() (in a different file) reads book.title. This visibility mismatch will cause a compile error and prevents printing the book title as required by the exercise.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the private access modifier from the Book.title property so it is accessible where needed. For example declare it as `let title: String` (or `public let title: String` if broader visibility is desired). This allows Client.main() to read and print the title without breaking encapsulation requirements in the exercise.
